svg.title: The shepherd Euphorbos carrying the infant Oedipus on his shoulder, a long spear in his hand
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Attic red-figure neck-amphora by the Achilles Painter, c. 450-445 BCE, Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, Cabinet des médailles 372; traced from photographs by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0), changed. This drawing is CC BY-SA 4.0.
